AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food food frying food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food food frying food.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food food frying food.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food food frying food.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Domestic Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Domestic Hygiene.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Domestic Hygiene.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Domestic Hygiene.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Domestic Hygiene.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fuel Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fuel Conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fuel Conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fuel Conservation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fuel Conservation.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Making Tacking Stitches? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Making Tacking Stitches.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Making Tacking Stitches.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Making Tacking Stitches.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Making Tacking Stitches.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Balanced Meal.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Balanced Meal.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Balanced Meal.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

17. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Fruits.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Fruits.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Fruits.

20. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Hygiene.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Hygiene.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Hygiene.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.

22. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Making Tacking Stitches and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Balanced Meal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

32. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food food frying food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
